source: The {0} format reads a message attribute as a key of its own: {1} on the message {2} is the key {3}. When a message is used, its attributes count as used too, since {4} reads them.
text: {0} 格式会把消息的属性读作独立的键：消息 {2} 上的 {1} 就是键 {3}。使用某条消息时，它的属性也会算作已使用，因为 {4} 会读取这些属性。
